text: [There is a squeal of static, then you hear a deep voice over the radio.] Command to patrol, command to patrol. What is your status? Over.
source_text:
[There is a squeal of static, then you hear a deep voice over the
 radio.] Command to patrol, command to patrol. What is your status?
 Over.

text: Eek!
source_text: Eek!

text: Uh, nothing is wrong here. We're fine, uh, how are you?
source_text: Uh, nothing is wrong here. We're fine, uh, how are you?

text: Command, we are under attack by a large group of armed humans. Request assistance. Over.
source_text:
Command, we are under attack by a large group of armed
 humans. Request assistance. Over.

text: Help! Unknown attackers! Heavy damage! Coordinates follow: 10 . . . Argh!
source_text: Help! Unknown attackers! Heavy damage! Coordinates follow: 10 . . . Argh!

text: Understood, patrol. We are sending assistance now. Over.
source_text: Understood, patrol. We are sending assistance now. Over.

text: Who is this? What is your purpose?
source_text: Who is this? What is your purpose?

text: My purpose is to shut the hell up.
source_text: My purpose is to shut the hell up.

text: I'm, uh, oh, never mind. I'm just going to kill you all anyways.
source_text: I'm, uh, oh, never mind. I'm just going to kill you all anyways.

text: This is, hmm, Fred. My purpose is patrol. I guess I'm a, uh, little dazed after that fall.
source_text:
This is, hmm, Fred. My purpose is patrol. I guess I'm a, uh,
 little dazed after that fall.

text: Understood, patrol. What are your coordinates?
source_text: Understood, patrol. What are your coordinates?

text: Four miles, south-southwest.
source_text: Four miles, south-southwest.

text: Gamma sector, at Omicron-Delta-Beta.
source_text: Gamma sector, at Omicron-Delta-Beta.

text: Understood, patrol. Command, out.
source_text: Understood, patrol. Command, out.

text: Understood, patrol. We are sending reinforcements.
source_text: Understood, patrol. We are sending reinforcements.

text: Ah, that explains it. We are sending help now.
source_text: Ah, that explains it. We are sending help now.

text: Roger, patrol. We're sending help now! Hold on!
source_text: Roger, patrol. We're sending help now! Hold on!

text: There is only static on the radio.
source_text: There is only static on the radio.

text: You hear some chatter on the radio. You listen for a while, and discover nothing of importance.
source_text:
You hear some chatter on the radio. You listen for a
 while, and discover nothing of importance.

text: The radio has a red blinking light. You hear a high pitched squealing over the radio speaker.
source_text:
The radio has a red blinking light. You hear a high
 pitched squealing over the radio speaker.

text: It sounds like encrypted audio.
source_text: It sounds like encrypted audio.

text: You send the command code to toggle the force field settings.
source_text:
You send the command code to toggle the force field
 settings.

text: There is only quiet static on the radio channel.
source_text: There is only quiet static on the radio channel.

text: The radio is not functioning.
source_text: The radio is not functioning.

text: This radio is in perfect condition. The source of the problem must be external.
source_text:
This radio is in perfect condition. The source
 of the problem must be external.

text: There is nothing but the squeal of encrypted data over the radio.
source_text:
There is nothing but the squeal of encrypted data
 over the radio.

text: [Squeal-snick-pop] Command here, go ahead patrol.
source_text: [Squeal-snick-pop] Command here, go ahead patrol.

text: Ack!
source_text: Ack!

text: Uh, sorry, Command. I hit the talk button by mistake.
source_text: Uh, sorry, Command. I hit the talk button by mistake.

text: Intruders in the base! Sound the alert!
source_text: Intruders in the base! Sound the alert!

text: Roger Patrol, Command out.
source_text: Roger Patrol, Command out.

text: [You dial the frequency of the radio to the security control channel] [Click!] Enter access number. [Click!]
source_text:
[You dial the frequency of the radio to the security control
 channel] [Click!] Enter access number. [Click!]

text: Hng!
source_text: Hng!

text: End access.
source_text: End access.

text: Automatic security channel shutdown.
source_text: Automatic security channel shutdown.

text: You gain 1,500 experience points for tricking the mutant guards.
source_text: You gain 1,500 experience points for tricking the mutant guards.
